name: Vincent
description: A Lord of the Pit summoned by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar who proposes marriage to her.

description_citations.text: "Distant Planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar becomes Vincent's chef to avoid being eaten, then is freed but hunted by creatures her cookbook calls delicious.
timeline.quote: After her time is up, Vincent proposes to marry her, but she turns him down, and he releases her to the overworld as promised.
